results.title: Seahawks WR Jake Bobo sustains 'serious' knee injury
results.description: Seattle Seahawks wide receiver Jake Bobo sustained a "serious" knee injury on Friday during a joint practice session with the Tennessee Titans in Nashville, head coach Mike Macdonald said.
